limits: Native plugins are trusted local processes, not a sandbox
Synthetic source only; physical devices, consumer file-fsync telemetry and weak-machine resources not accepted
10-second full snapshots are supplemented with raw references/result checks; restore needs compatible algorithms and validates every regenerated result.
Selected-interval restore contains a validated baseline, not pre-interval sample history.
Open .kbk files require the adjacent durable .tail; closed hours are self-contained.
No common secondary-writer shutdown drain, CSV periods or primary redb rotation.
Standalone-interval re-export with raw dependencies before its baseline is not guaranteed; prefer the whole collection after a deep cross-boundary interpreter backlog.
